name: scrollchain-meta-index
description: Sovereign kernel minting and dashboard deployment for ScrollChainOS

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd sovereign-annuity-dapp && npm install && cd ../my-smart-wallets-app && npm install && cd ../scroll-prophecy && npm install && cd ..
scripts.setup-smart-wallets: cd my-smart-wallets-app && npm install && cp .env.example .env.local && echo '✅ Smart wallets app setup complete! Edit my-smart-wallets-app/.env.local with your API keys.'
scripts.quick-setup: npm install && npm run setup-smart-wallets && echo '🚀 Quick setup complete! Run "npm run dev-smart-wallets" to start the smart wallets app.'
